purpose: Define mocked/stubbed services, models, tools and dependencies as explicit test doubles with declared behavior and compatibility scope.

topics.name: Mock and Stub Identity
topics.purpose: Define mocked/stubbed services, models, tools and dependencies as explicit test doubles with declared behavior and compatibility scope.

semantics.identity_rule: Each test double has an explicit identity/version.
semantics.target_rule: Emulated real dependency identity/interface is exact.
semantics.compatibility_rule: Mock compatibility surface is explicit and cannot imply complete equivalence.
semantics.network_rule: Mock endpoint binding is test environment metadata.
semantics.label_rule: Mock must remain identifiable as non-production.
semantics.authority_rule: Mock behavior/credentials grant no production authority.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: mock endpoint accidentally selected in production

references.purpose: Mocks declare exact supported capability surface.
